android.statusMessage: Signed release APK awaits release keystore & Android SDK build pipeline. Debug APKs are intentionally never distributed publicly. Install the Ping Progressive Web App immediately on Android Chrome below.

pwa.statusMessage: Install Ping directly to your home screen with zero app-store wait. Updates automatically and supports offline fallback.

ios.statusMessage: Native iOS TestFlight archive requires macOS, Xcode, and Apple Developer signing credentials. iPhone and iPad users can install Ping immediately via Safari Add to Home Screen (PWA) and join the TestFlight waitlist below.
